title: Calibrations in Dexcom are causing duplicate value alerts and suspending closed loop
symptom: Any time a calibration is entered in Dexcom, APS shows a red exclamation next to the blood sugar and a glucose value is marked as an out of normal sequence duplicate. This error occurs even when Dexcom does not accept the calibration and the Dexcom app shows no duplicate or extra readings. The supposed duplicate reading flagged in APS has a different time stamp from any other readings, confirming that it is not a duplicate. This is problematic as a calibration should not break the loop; the user has to manually delete the supposed duplicate value and restart the loop.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. One commenter mentions that 'diaKem sending double values to AAPS is a known problem', but this is not confirmed by the maintainers.
fix: The thread does not provide a resolution. The maintainer requested logs and then closed the issue for inactivity.
evidence_quote: diaKem sending doube values to AAPS is a known problem.
